messages:
samir_customer: Hey @support — our production API started returning 429s intermittently around 2026-10-03 14:12 UTC, high priority. Request IDs: req_01a2f3, req_01a2f4. We're seeing it across multiple tenants. Anyone seen this pattern?

alex_support: thanks Samir. Can you paste the exact curl you used or HAR? Also which region and API key (masked) TTL?

samir_customer: repro curl attached. using eu-west-1, tokens rotated yesterday. curl: `curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{\"model\":\"rw-large\",\"input\":\"hi\"}'` We got 429 with headers `x-rw-req: req_01a2f3` and `x-rw-quota: 0/1000`.

mira_eng: pinging infra, can you share the full response headers and timestamp window? Any pattern in burstiness?

samir_customer: headers snippet and timeline: 14:12:03 200, 14:12:08 200, 14:12:12 429 req_01a2f3, 14:12:13 429 req_01a2f4, 14:12:20 200. Token-level quotas? We're not batching.

alex_support: can you run a curl repro with `-v` and include `X-Request-Id` in header to ensure mapping? Example: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H "X-Request-Id: local-repro-001" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rw-large","input":"test"}'` Also attach a debug bundle via /support/debug-bundle.

devon_repro: quick note — our per-token leaky-bucket plus global token-bank can cause short bursts of 429s when quota smoothing triggers. Need exact request ids to correlate with ratelimit windows.

juan_sre: I'm pulling proxy logs for the window, grabbing conn and token metrics. If you can provide one failing response body (JSON) that contains `code: "rate_limit_exceeded"` that'll help.

samir_customer: failing body: `{"error":{"message":"Rate limit exceeded","type":"rate_limit_error","code":"rate_limit_exceeded"}}` — attached HAR and curl -v output.

ops-bot: debug-bundle created: db-1887654321-388.tar.gz — uploaded to internal ticket #SUP-912. Trace id mapping: req_01a2f3 -> trace-77b, req_01a2f4 -> trace-77c.

mira_eng: saw correlated proxy throttles at 14:12:11-14:12:14 from eu-west-1-primaries; tokens hit `bucket_remaining=0` for short window. Possibly a quota-smoothing miscalc after quota refill at billing rollovers.

alex_support: next steps: (1) juan to share logpack (2) samir to run reproducible script that sends 5 requests/s for 30s with `X-Request-Id` set, and capture one failing response with headers `x-rw-remaining` and `x-rw-reset` (3) we'll attach to escalation to infra.

samir_customer: running now, results: sending 25 requests -> got 3x 429 at seq 12-14. headers on 429: `x-rw-remaining: 0`, `x-rw-reset: 14`, `x-rw-req: req_local_12`. Uploading HAR.

mira_eng: thanks. Juan, can you check whether quota smoothing incorrectly used epoch boundaries? Also check for concurrent global reserve consumption.

juan_sre: confirming proxy shows two quota resets recorded at 14:12:10 and 14:12:20; smoothing logic double-applied the refill for some tokens -> temporary oversubscription. I've opened an infra bug and put a hotfix branch up.

devon_repro: suggested mitigation for customers: stagger startup bursts, set client-side leaky-bucket to 10 qps, and implement exponential retry with jitter. We'll patch docs.

alex_support: closing loop with customer once hotfix rolled. Samir — expect follow-up in ~30m. Thanks :thumbsup:

samir_customer: appreciated — will test again after hotfix.
